# anthropic_webhooks (Data Source)

Beta. Lists the organization's webhook endpoints (`GET /v1/organizations/webhooks`). Workspace webhook endpoints are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_webhooks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) Organization webhook endpoints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the endpoint was created.
- `description` (String) Notes about the endpoint. Empty when none were given.
- `disabled_reason` (String) Why Anthropic disabled the endpoint automatically. Empty when enabled or disabled by you.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent to the endpoint.
- `enabled_events` (Set of String) Event types delivered to the endpoint.
- `id` (String) ID of the webhook endpoint.
- `name` (String) Short label for the endpoint. Empty when none was given.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the endpoint was last changed.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL that deliveries are sent to.
